tools.description: expires_at is when the account stops working (RFC 3339), or null for never. Once it passes the account counts as disabled: sign-in, its sessions and its keys stop, and housekeeping disables it and revokes its access. A later expiry does not re-enable an account housekeeping already disabled. It must be in the future. The owner's account never expires; only the owner sets an admin's.

tools.name: cancel_my_login_link
tools.title: Stop your own login link working

tools.description: A link that signs your own account in on a browser or another device. An API key may ask only if your account let it, from a browser session (POST /api/keys/{key_id}/sign-in); its link works once, for at most 15 minutes. Only works if this key was allowed to make sign-in links, on the API keys card. Answers with login_url (open it to sign in; it works once, for at most 15 minutes), expires_at and max_uses. Any older link the account could still use stops working; its signed-in devices stay signed in. Revoking or deleting this API key voids the link while it is unused, and signs out every device it signed in.

expires_in_minutes.description: 0 never expires. Default auth.login_token_ttl_seconds for a link that works once, auth.multi_use_login_token_ttl_seconds otherwise.

max_uses.description: Sign-ins the link allows: 1-1000, or 0 for unlimited. Default 1.
